closingDefinition: date=<kickoff minute bucket>; API returns closest snapshot ≤ date (last pre-kickoff prices). Midday slate snaps are not closes.

snapshotTiming.primaryDateParam: ESPN kickoffIso truncated to UTC minute
snapshotTiming.intervalNote: Odds historical snaps at 5-minute intervals since Sep 2022
snapshotTiming.retryWhen: if returned snapshotTimestamp >= Odds commence_time, re-fetch at commence then previous_timestamp until snapshot < commence
snapshotTiming.rejectIf: still snapshot_not_before_commence after retries → MISSING_DATA for that game

twoSidedOdds.engineM3Uses: closeMlHome implied prob (American→prob); away ML retained for audit/CLV, not invented from vig-free invert
twoSidedOdds.engineS2Uses: closeSpreadHome line for ATS settlement vs engine cover probs
twoSidedOdds.s4MarketAts: requires two-sided spread juice; if absent report MISSING_DATA (do not invent -110)
twoSidedOdds.earlyT24h: NOT in this dry-run scope; optional CLV add-on at similar credit cost

deduplication.note: Retry commence/previous timestamps also cache by date string; duplicate games in same minute share one primary request

missingDataHandling.api_non_200: count api_errors; mark all games in bucket missing reason api_<status>; do not invent prices
missingDataHandling.injury: injuryKnown/qbOut stay null — never coerce to false
doNotInvent: away ML from vig-free invert for CLV R2

evalOnlyIsolation.rule: Historical closing snapshots are evaluation join inputs only. They must not enter pregame drive-sim / matchup feature vectors or live Coach sim inputs.

creditMath.formula: 10 × markets × regions per historical featured request
creditMath.retryBufferPolicy: 25% of base for commence/previousTimestamp re-fetches (unknown pre-run; 2024 close run rarely needed full retry chain)

planSupport.freeTier: 500 credits/mo — insufficient AND historical not available on free
planSupport.note: Historical costs 10× within the same monthly credit pool — no separate historical SKU fee. Account remaining credits UNKNOWN this turn (ODDS_API_KEY unset; no probe).

dollarImpact.ifOnFreeTier: Must upgrade to any paid plan before historical works; cheapest paid is $30/mo (20K credits) which covers TUNING closes with headroom
